mass.title: The client served itself
mass.description: Link onboarding to AI support to double company support capacity. Compute capacity remains a separate limit.
mass.tradeoff: Replaces personal support. Hosting +$32 per sprint.

premium.title: Now that is enterprise
premium.description: CRM v2 linked to AI support lets large companies accept a price up to ×2 without a price penalty. You set the price yourself.
premium.tradeoff: Replaces mass support. With batch processing, the penalty-free price limit is ×1.25. Hosting +$96 per sprint.

batch.title: Your answer was ready yesterday
batch.description: Collect requests into batches and run the model once for the whole group.
batch.tradeoff: Large companies: satisfaction −12. Companies needing instant answers become less satisfied and stop joining. Replaces instant answers; contract patience −1.

instant.title: While you were typing
instant.description: Instant answers make clients recommend the product and wait longer for improvements.
instant.tradeoff: Replaces batches. Tokens +20%, hosting +$48 per sprint.

leads.title: Someone noticed us in a chat
leads.description: Prepare a demo for four new companies.
leads.tradeoff: Potential clients need free seats and a working product.

consulting.title: One tiny consulting job
consulting.description: A one-time side project pays for the next product improvements. This contract is available once per startup.
consulting.tradeoff: Six work from the shared queue. This contract cannot be taken again.

credits.title: Provider credits
credits.description: Apply for an infrastructure grant: the provider pays for the next project. Available once per startup.
credits.tradeoff: Three work from the shared queue. This grant cannot be claimed again.

maintenance.title: Before anyone complains
maintenance.description: Pay down technical debt before the next outage. The fixes take effect at release.
maintenance.tradeoff: Six work from the shared queue. Adds no new features.

rest.title: The founder stepped outside
rest.description: The team prepares a quiet release. The founder returns with fresh energy.
rest.tradeoff: Four work from the shared queue. Energy cannot exceed its maximum.
